cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now I'm back, give me a straight answer, like I taught you. Was the flat too quiet without me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good bargaining. Answer first: when you heard a key, did you hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a proper answer. Here's your demonstration: I rang our landline just to hear your voice. Could you say hello again?

reason: Replace the removable teaching prefaces with pupil corrections that directly change how A pursues the exact Drive. Preserve the specific partner contribution and make the ending answer it.
